title: mailbox-open: a cloud seat must push its own --head branch, and --close never deletes it, so every cloud seating leaves a stray claude/ branch
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpFBMr917PmVkG9up7

Filing gate: ③. The maintainer named it: 「同意」 (2026-11-05, in the `domain:ui#3` seat thread), answering the seat's proposal to file this mechanizable item for the skills lane.

## Business reason

Every cloud-session seat that opens a mailbox leaves a branch behind on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` that nothing ever removes. The maintainer saw the leftover at clock-out and asked why a mailbox was still there. Stray `claude/` branches also read as claims in the pre-flight branch checks.

## Measured (`domain:ui#3`, 2026-11-04 → 05)

1. `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --seat 'domain:ui#3' --login os-justin` exited 3. Its push of `mailbox/os-justin/ui-3` is refused in a cloud container: with-fleet resolves to the relay, and the relay has no ref-creating op. The tool's own message points to `--head <a branch this session pushed>`.
2. The seat pushed an empty-commit branch, `claude/mailbox-ui-3` (`3a4a42af7`), and opened mailbox #30141 with `--head`.
3. At clock-out, `mailbox-open.mjs --close 30141` closed the PR and left the branch.
4. `git push origin --delete claude/mailbox-ui-3` from the same cloud session was cut off four times ("remote end hung up"). The branch is still on the remote. The seat cannot clean up after itself.

## Site

`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`: the `--head` path (header ②) and `--close`. The relay op table, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`, has no ref create or delete op.

## Acceptance (for the skills lane to shape)

A cloud seat can open and close a mailbox without leaving a branch it cannot remove. Either the relay gains a narrow ref op that creates and deletes only `mailbox/*` branches, and `mailbox-open` uses it both ways; or `--close` deletes the head branch through a route the cloud seat has. The self-test pins that the close leaves no branch.

## Reader who acts

Triage routes this card; `scripts/pm/**` and the relay belong to the skills lane.

## Dedupe (open and closed)

`mailbox-open close head branch is:issue`: 45 hits; `mailbox branch delete is:issue`: 112 hits. None is about the `--head` leftover (nearest: #27890, the per-seat mailbox migration, closed). **New.**

## Re-check

`git ls-remote origin refs/heads/claude/mailbox-ui-3`
